promptEs: El acorde suena Fa, La y Do, de grave a agudo. ¿Qué cifrado latino le corresponde?
promptEn: The chord sounds F, A and C, from low to high. Which American chord symbol matches it?
explanationEs: Fa es la fundamental; Fa-La es una tercera mayor y Fa-Do una quinta justa. Es una tríada mayor y el cifrado no lleva sufijo: Fa. En americano se escribe F.
explanationEn: F is the root; F-A is a major third and F-C a perfect fifth. It is a major triad and the symbol has no suffix: F. In Latin notation it is written Fa.
